notes: 3-4-3 consensus: Suzuki; Gabriel, Van Hecke, Konsa; Tavernier, Manzambi, Palmer, Rogers; Haaland, N.Jackson, Evanilson. Captain Haaland. Joao Pedro is a universal sell (out 'a few weeks'); N.Jackson is the top replacement (Isak/Evanilson alternatives). Disagreement: PL Scout says sell B.Fernandes, Mbeumo, Calvert-Lewin and buy Gabriel now, while FFS says hold Gabriel until GW10 (away at Liverpool). GK split Suzuki vs Raya/Verbruggen. PL Scout Selection XI for GW9 not yet published.
